law_name: Law No. 91-12 of 10 June 1991 on the Protection of Copyright, Folklore and Related Rights
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (per Commons summary; folklore protected without time limit) (unconfirmed)
author_rights: Economic rights (patrimonial attributes; art. 3 also recognises intellectual and moral attributes)
moral_rights: Moral rights recognized (art. 3); details not seen (unconfirmed)
digital_protection: UNKNOWN (law predates ICT; reform bill under preparation per BUTODRA 2022) (unconfirmed)
enforcement_body: Togolese Copyright Office (Bureau togolais du droit d'auteur, BUTODRA)
notes: National law applies alongside OAPI/Bangui membership (revised Bangui ratified by Law 2001-013). WCT and WPPT in force 21 May 2003 (WIPO). Berne/TRIPS from EU IP helpdesk fiche only. Implementing decree 91-199 organises BUTODRA. A new copyright bill was announced in 2022; adoption not confirmed. Law 2016-012 concerns artist status, not copyright.
